content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.annotation(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.annotation(@x, Real)), Analysis.locallyBounded(F, x), Logic.exists-typed(@delta, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(delta), Logic.exists-typed(@M, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(M), Logic.forall-typed(@y, Real, Logic.implies(Set.mem(y, Set.inter(Analysis.domain(F), Analysis.nbh(x, delta))), $\left|#0\right| < #1$(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), y), M))))))))

values.en:
`F` is bounded near `x₀` iff it is bounded on the intersection of its domain with some neighbourhood of `x₀`. This is the conclusion available from convergence at a point: a function with a limit at `x₀` is locally bounded there, never globally.

The variants at `±∞` replace the neighbourhood by a ray.
values.zh-CN:
`F` 在 `x₀` 附近有界，当且仅当它在其定义域与 `x₀` 某个邻域的交集上有界。这是函数在一点收敛时能够得到的结论：在 `x₀` 处有极限的函数在那里局部有界，而非全局有界。

`±∞` 处的变体用射线替代邻域。
